title: MVP is a TOTAL REWRITE - build the dashboard from scratch (take NOTHING from pipeline_dashboard)
body: Owner directive: the new dashboard is a TOTAL REWRITE. Do NOT take/reuse anything from the deprecated pipeline_dashboard/ (archived; read-only). Ignore its routes/components as implementation references. The live dashboard/ (server.py + static/index.html shell) is the starting point and must be rebuilt into the full API + UI surface from scratch, consuming the pipeline backend as the single source of truth. Sets scope for BI-0015/BI-0018/BI-0027/BI-0041/0042.
